🐾 Hope Haven Animal Rescue ❤️

We are dedicated to helping abandoned, neglected, and vulnerable animals find safety, care, and a second chance.

Our mission is to provide compassionate rescue support, veterinary care, rehabilitation, foster placement, and adoption opportunities. We share rescue stories to raise awareness and help connect animals with loving homes.

We believe every animal deserves kindness, dignity, and the opportunity for a better future.

📍 Austin, Texas, USA 🇺🇸
📞 Contact us: +1 (770) 626-0965
📧 Email: kindhopefulrescue@gmail.com

💗 Support our mission:
Donations help support veterinary care, medication, food, transportation, foster care, and other rescue needs.

👉 Donate through the PayPal link below.

Join us by following, sharing, fostering, adopting, or supporting our mission.

🐾 Every life matters. Every paw deserves hope. ❤️
